scope: One queue-owned infrastructure diagnostic. No robot, candidate, task episode, held-out manifest, scored retry, source change, or continuation decision.
phases: 30 seconds of host-only sampling with no model server
One unchanged LocalModel startup, then 30 seconds with the loaded model idle
120 seconds of sequential requests using the single fixed generic prompt and schema; at most 120 calls, one in flight
sampler_instances: One host-only sampler, then one loaded-model sampler continuous across idle and inference. Both use the frozen five-second schedule, two-second GPU query, and seven-second initial/freshness rules. The host sampler stops before model startup, matching the original exclusion of model startup from resource-sampling coverage.
generic_prompt: Return a JSON object with a words array containing twenty distinct common English names of trees. Use lowercase words. Do not add any other fields.
instrumentation: Unchanged ResourceSampler capture/run bodies execute with injected timed Windows-process/GPU readers. GPU helper and installed subprocess.run execute their original code objects with private globals, substituting only a GPU-specific timed Popen subclass. There is no global subprocess.run/Popen patch. Calls record process lookup/read, GPU process creation, communicate timeout, kill, unbounded Windows drain, wait/context exit, resource write/flush, and publication. A contained child makes the diagnostic's outer wall limit independent of a hung native call.
queue_state_reader: Parent ownership executes the unchanged queued_job code object with a private load override only for QUEUE_STATE. Parent and child read live queue state through a hidden PowerShell FileStream with Read access and ReadWrite|Delete sharing, disposing the stream before returning the snapshot. Other artifact loads are unchanged. No shared module mutation, ordinary live-state open, queue status call, admission, maintenance or queue write is performed by this helper.
stop_rule: Stop new captures and requests on the first observation/watchdog/model failure. Do not retry a query or model request. Preserve every stage marker, exception and original resource row. Diagnostic collection may finish successfully while reporting an observed failure; that is not a passing health or readiness result.
cleanup: A request already admitted at the end of the 120-second submission window may drain within its unchanged 30-second request budget; no fresh request is admitted. Parent allows at most 480 seconds for the complete child, including startup and cleanup. The original five-second sampler close is tried first. If it times out, retain that failure and allow ten additional seconds solely to observe the already-in-flight query's cleanup; this is not an observation grace or episode extension. Unresolved cleanup is a diagnostic failure. The parent's Windows kill-on-close job contains child/model/GPU descendants.
source_and_evidence: Record queue ownership, exact parent/child argv, actual script/plan/helper/Runtime Python sources, installed subprocess.py, interpreter and model asset manifest hashes before and after. LocalModel performs its unchanged model/executable verification. Fresh output only, immutable parent manifest, raw per-thread stage logs, original resource JSONL, original model log, generic responses and compact result/report. No automatic execution or evidence overwrite.
limitations: Timing hooks and flushed stage logs add diagnostic overhead; this is not a timing-equivalence or scored-readiness test.
A timeout reproduced in a named stage can locate an observed delay, but does not alone establish the underlying Windows or GPU-driver cause.
One bounded nonreproduction cannot prove nonrecurrence or authorize scored continuation.
Generic service load is not a replay of A3, robot physics, sensing, policy prompts, or held-out scenarios; negative results do not exclude an interaction with the full workload.
The 30/30/120-second phases total 180 seconds; model startup, a final in-flight request and bounded cleanup are separately recorded outside those phase durations.

The unchanged Windows subprocess timeout path can spend time in process creation or post-kill drain outside its communicate timeout; the independent parent wall limit bounds only this diagnostic, not the frozen sampler.
